title: Resident of the Eastern Slope
synopsis: Su Shi, also known as Dongpo Jushi, meaning the “Resident of the Eastern Slope“, was a gifted poet and statesman of the Northern Song dynasty, and is also remembered for his celebrated culinary creations.

series.title: The Splendor of the Song Dynasty

fullText.simplified:
东坡居士——宋朝文官的人生课题

    说起北宋文学家，苏轼是绕不开的里程碑式人物，他打破了宋词以婉约风格为主的传统，开创了豪放一派。他的词豪放大气，是他乐观性格的展现。这种性格不仅促使他在文学上取得令人瞩目的成就，也让他以豁达之心面对人生逆境。
    苏轼，号东坡居士，四川人，是北宋中期著名的文学家和政治家。他父亲是一个很有才华的人，从小就教导他和弟弟读书。20岁时，苏轼前往首都参加科举，取得了第二名的好成绩。至于为什么不是第一名，据说有个小故事。北宋科举考试采用“糊名制”，就是将考卷上考生的名字遮掩，让阅卷人不知道考生的名字，以彰显阅卷的公正性。当时的阅卷人是欧阳修（另一位北宋有名的文学家和政治家），他看到苏轼的考卷，觉得写得太好了，应该是第一名。但因为他自己的学生也参加了考试，他以为这是他的学生的考卷，为了避嫌，就只给了第二名。成绩公布时，欧阳修才知道这是苏轼的文章，因此对苏轼格外赞赏。就在苏轼准备在首都大展身手时，他的母亲去世了，于是他回乡为母守丧。守丧期满后，恰逢朝廷举办选拔人才的特别考试。苏轼参加了考试，并取得了最优等成绩，从此踏入政坛。29岁时，苏轼的父亲去世，他又返回四川为父亲守丧，这期间仕途暂缓。三年后，苏轼重回政坛，重新开启政治生涯。
    苏轼富有才学，政绩优秀，升职很快。但他性格不拘小节，不懂收起锋芒，逐渐受人嫉妒。42岁那年，有人拿着一些他写的诗词，曲解文意后，向皇帝举报他讽刺朝廷、不忠于皇帝，于是他被抓进了监狱，面临被杀的风险。在监狱的日子里，苏轼备受煎熬，甚至写下绝命诗给弟弟。这段经历让他深刻体会到政治的险恶，成为其思想与文学创作的重要转折点。三个月后，在弟弟和其他政界人士的帮助下，皇帝赦免了苏轼的死罪，将他贬谪到湖北黄州。
    当时的湖北黄州是穷乡僻壤，生活条件非常艰苦。苏轼很长一段时间都借住在寺庙中，后来条件稍好才带领家人搬出寺庙。他在朋友的帮助下得到一块荒地，开始垦荒种田的生活。这块荒地是城东的一块坡地，名叫东坡，苏轼因此笑称自己是“东坡居士”。在黄州的生活虽然艰苦，但苏轼却用乐观的心态发掘着生命中的美好。相传当时黄州百姓买不起羊肉，只能买些肥腻的猪肉吃。他就仔细研究，发明了肥而不腻的“东坡肉”，成为千古名菜。在黄州的这段岁月是苏轼文学创作的巅峰期，他在与朋友游山玩水，通过大自然治愈自己的过程中，写下了千古名篇《赤壁赋》，这是他的人生代表作之一。从这里开始，他的作品转向人生哲理性思考，政治议题减少并转为隐喻。
    47岁时，苏轼接到调令，离开了生活了四年的黄州。之后的岁月里，苏轼经历了反复升职和被贬。他每到一个地方都会结交新朋友，发掘当地美食，为当地老百姓办实事，包括修整堤坝、兴办教育等，现在杭州的“苏堤”就是他的执政成果。最终，他在64岁时于常州病逝。
    这就是苏轼的一生：怀抱着为生民立命的儒家理想走进政坛，却在政治斗争中质疑理想。最终他跟自己和解，走出了权力中心，一心为百姓做实事。东坡居士在黄州城东的土坡上放下了一部分理想，坚持了一部分理想，回答了自己的人生课题。
fullText.traditional:
東坡居士——宋朝文官的人生課題

    說起北宋文學家，蘇軾是繞不開的里程碑式人物，他打破了宋詞以婉約風格為主的傳統，開創了豪放一派。他的詞豪放大氣，是他樂觀性格的展現。這種性格不僅促使他在文學上取得令人矚目的成就，也讓他以豁達之心面對人生逆境。
    蘇軾，號東坡居士，四川人，是北宋中期著名的文學家和政治家。他父親是一個很有才華的人，從小就教導他和弟弟讀書。20歲時，蘇軾前往首都參加科舉，取得了第二名的好成績。至於為什麼不是第一名，據說有個小故事。北宋科舉考試採用“糊名制”，就是將考卷上考生的名字遮掩，讓閱卷人不知道考生的名字，以彰顯閱卷的公正性。當時的閱卷人是歐陽修（另一位北宋有名的文學家和政治家），他看到蘇軾的考卷，覺得寫得太好了，應該是第一名。但因為他自己的學生也參加了考試，他以為這是他的學生的考卷，為了避嫌，就只給了第二名。成績公佈時，歐陽修才知道這是蘇軾的文章，因此對蘇軾格外讚賞。就在蘇軾準備在首都大展身手時，他的母親去世了，於是他回鄉為母守喪。守喪期滿後，恰逢朝廷舉辦選拔人才的特別考試。蘇軾參加了考試，並取得了最優等成績，從此踏入政壇。29歲時，蘇軾的父親去世，他又返回四川為父親守喪，這期間仕途暫緩。三年後，蘇軾重回政壇，重新開啟政治生涯。
    蘇軾富有才學，政績優秀，升職很快。但他性格不拘小節，不懂收起鋒芒，逐漸受人嫉妒。42歲那年，有人拿著一些他寫的詩詞，曲解文意後，向皇帝舉報他諷刺朝廷、不忠於皇帝，於是他被抓進了監獄，面臨被殺的風險。在監獄的日子裡，蘇軾備受煎熬，甚至寫下絕命詩給弟弟。這段經歷讓他深刻體會到政治的險惡，成為其思想與文學創作的重要轉折點。三個月後，在弟弟和其他政界人士的幫助下，皇帝赦免了蘇軾的死罪，將他貶謫到湖北黃州。
    當時的湖北黃州是窮鄉僻壤，生活條件非常艱苦。蘇軾很長一段時間都借住在寺廟中，後來條件稍好才帶領家人搬出寺廟。他在朋友的幫助下得到一塊荒地，開始墾荒種田的生活。這塊荒地是城東的一塊坡地，名叫東坡，蘇軾因此笑稱自己是“東坡居士”。在黃州的生活雖然艱苦，但蘇軾卻用樂觀的心態發掘著生命中的美好。相傳當時黃州百姓買不起羊肉，只能買些肥膩的豬肉吃。他就仔細研究，發明了肥而不膩的“東坡肉”，成為千古名菜。在黃州的這段歲月是蘇軾文學創作的巔峰期，他在與朋友遊山玩水，通過大自然治癒自己的過程中，寫下了千古名篇《赤壁賦》，這是他的人生代表作之一。從這裡開始，他的作品轉向人生哲理性思考，政治議題減少並轉為隱喻。
    47歲時，蘇軾接到調令，離開了生活了四年的黃州。之後的歲月裡，蘇軾經歷了反覆升職和被貶。他每到一個地方都會結交新朋友，發掘當地美食，為當地老百姓辦實事，包括修整堤壩、興辦教育等，現在杭州的“蘇堤”就是他的執政成果。最終，他在64歲時於常州病逝。
    這就是蘇軾的一生：懷抱著為生民立命的儒家理想走進政壇，卻在政治鬥爭中質疑理想。最終他跟自己和解，走出了權力中心，一心為百姓做實事。東坡居士在黃州城東的土坡上放下了一部分理想，堅持了一部分理想，回答了自己的人生課題。

sentences.pinyin: 3 suì nà nián yǒu rén ná zhe yì xiē tā xiě de shī cí qū jiě wén yì hòu
sentences.english: .. he gradually became the object of envy.

sentences.simplified: 向皇帝举报他讽刺朝廷、不忠于皇帝，
sentences.traditional: 向皇帝舉報他諷刺朝廷、不忠於皇帝，
sentences.pinyin: xiàng huáng dì jǔ bào tā fěng cì cháo tíng bù zhōng yú huáng dì
sentences.english: When he was forty-two, someone took a number of his poems, distorted their meaning, ..

sentences.simplified: 于是他被抓进了监狱，面临被杀的风险。
sentences.traditional: 於是他被抓進了監獄，面臨被殺的風險。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā bèi zhuā jìn le jiān yù miàn lín bèi shā de fēng xiǎn
sentences.english: .. and reported him to the emperor for satirizing the court and being disloyal to the emperor.

sentences.simplified: 在监狱的日子里，苏轼备受煎熬，甚至写下绝命诗给弟弟。
sentences.traditional: 在監獄的日子裡，蘇軾備受煎熬，甚至寫下絕命詩給弟弟。
sentences.pinyin: zài jiān yù de rì zi lǐ sū shì bèi shòu jiān áo shèn zhì xiě xià jué mìng shī gěi dì di
sentences.english: As a result, he was arrested and imprisoned, and faced the risk of execution.

sentences.simplified: 这段经历让他深刻体会到政治的险恶，
sentences.traditional: 這段經歷讓他深刻體會到政治的險惡，
sentences.pinyin: zhè duàn jīng lì ràng tā shēn kè tǐ huì dào zhèng zhì de xiǎn è
sentences.english: During his days in prison, Su Shi endured great torment and even wrote a farewell poem to his younger brother.

sentences.simplified: 成为其思想与文学创作的重要转折点。
sentences.traditional: 成為其思想與文學創作的重要轉折點。
sentences.pinyin: chéng wéi qí sī xiǎng yǔ wén xué chuàng zuò de zhòng yào zhuǎn zhé diǎn
sentences.english: This experience gave him a profound understanding of the treacherous nature of politics, ..

sentences.simplified: 三个月后，在弟弟和其他政界人士的帮助下，
sentences.traditional: 三個月後，在弟弟和其他政界人士的幫助下，
sentences.pinyin: sān ge yuè hòu zài dì di hé qí tā zhèng jiè rén shì de bāng zhù xià
sentences.english: .. and became an important turning point in his thoughts and literary creation.

sentences.simplified: 皇帝赦免了苏轼的死罪，将他贬谪到湖北黄州。
sentences.traditional: 皇帝赦免了蘇軾的死罪，將他貶謫到湖北黃州。
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì shè miǎn le sū shì de sǐ zuì jiāng tā biǎn zhé dào hú běi huáng zhōu
sentences.english: Three months later, with the help of his younger brother and other political figures, ..
.. the emperor commuted Su Shi’s death sentence and exiled him to Huangzhou in Hubei.

sentences.simplified: 当时的湖北黄州是穷乡僻壤，生活条件非常艰苦。
sentences.traditional: 當時的湖北黃州是窮鄉僻壤，生活條件非常艱苦。
sentences.pinyin: dāng shí de hú běi huáng zhōu shì qióng xiāng pì rǎng shēng huó tiáo jiàn fēi cháng jiān kǔ

sentences.simplified: 苏轼很长一段时间都借住在寺庙中，后来条件稍好才带领家人搬出寺庙。
sentences.traditional: 蘇軾很長一段時間都借住在寺廟中，後來條件稍好才帶領家人搬出寺廟。
sentences.pinyin: sū shì hěn cháng yí duàn shí jiān dōu jiè zhù zài sì miào zhōng hòu lái tiáo jiàn shāo hǎo cái dài lǐng jiā rén bān chū sì miào
sentences.english: At that time, Huangzhou in Hubei was a remote and impoverished backwater with very harsh living conditions.

sentences.simplified: 他在朋友的帮助下得到一块荒地，开始垦荒种田的生活。
sentences.traditional: 他在朋友的幫助下得到一塊荒地，開始墾荒種田的生活。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài péng you de bāng zhù xià dé dào yí kuài huāng dì kāi shǐ kěn huāng zhòng tián de shēng huó
sentences.english: For a long period, Su Shi lodged in a temple. Later, when his circumstances improved somewhat, he moved out of the temple with his family.

sentences.simplified: 这块荒地是城东的一块坡地，名叫东坡，
sentences.traditional: 這塊荒地是城東的一塊坡地，名叫東坡，
sentences.pinyin: zhè kuài huāng dì shì chéng dōng de yí kuài pō dì míng jiào dōng pō
sentences.english: With the help of his friends, he obtained a piece of wasteland. He cleared the wasteland and began a life of farming.

sentences.simplified: 苏轼因此笑称自己是“东坡居士”。
sentences.traditional: 蘇軾因此笑稱自己是“東坡居士”。
sentences.pinyin: sū shì yīn cǐ xiào chēng zì jǐ shì dōng pō jū shì
sentences.english: This piece of wasteland was a slope on the east side of the city, called the Eastern Slope.

sentences.simplified: 在黄州的生活虽然艰苦，但苏轼却用乐观的心态发掘着生命中的美好。
sentences.traditional: 在黃州的生活雖然艱苦，但蘇軾卻用樂觀的心態發掘著生命中的美好。
sentences.pinyin: zài huáng zhōu de shēng huó suī rán jiān kǔ dàn sū shì què yòng lè guān de xīn tài fā jué zhe shēng mìng zhōng de měi hǎo
sentences.english: Su Shi therefore humorously referred to himself as the “Resident of the Eastern Slope”.

sentences.simplified: 相传当时黄州百姓买不起羊肉，只能买些肥腻的猪肉吃。
sentences.traditional: 相傳當時黃州百姓買不起羊肉，只能買些肥膩的豬肉吃。
sentences.pinyin: xiāng chuán dāng shí huáng zhōu bǎi xìng mǎi bù qǐ yáng ròu zhǐ néng mǎi xiē féi nì de zhū ròu chī
sentences.english: Although life in Huangzhou was difficult, Su Shi’s optimistic attitude helped him to discover the beauty in life.

sentences.simplified: 他就仔细研究，发明了肥而不腻的“东坡肉”，成为千古名菜。
sentences.traditional: 他就仔細研究，發明了肥而不膩的“東坡肉”，成為千古名菜。
sentences.pinyin: tā jiù zǐ xì yán jiū fā míng le féi ér bú nì de dōng pō ròu chéng wéi qiān gǔ míng cài
sentences.english: It is said that at that time, the people of Huangzhou could not afford mutton and could only buy fatty pork to eat.

sentences.simplified: 在黄州的这段岁月是苏轼文学创作的巅峰期，
sentences.traditional: 在黃州的這段歲月是蘇軾文學創作的巔峰期，
sentences.pinyin: zài huáng zhōu de zhè duàn suì yuè shì sū shì wén xué chuàng zuò de diān fēng qī
sentences.english: He carefully studied the matter and invented the fatty but not greasy “Dongpo pork”, which became a timeless classic.

sentences.simplified: 他在与朋友游山玩水，通过大自然治愈自己的过程中，
sentences.traditional: 他在與朋友遊山玩水，通過大自然治癒自己的過程中，
sentences.pinyin: tā zài yǔ péng you yóu shān wán shuǐ tōng guò dà zì rán zhì yù zì jǐ de guò chéng zhōng
sentences.english: Su Shi’s period in Huangzhou marked the peak of his literary creation.

sentences.simplified: 写下了千古名篇《赤壁赋》，这是他的人生代表作之一。
sentences.traditional: 寫下了千古名篇《赤壁賦》，這是他的人生代表作之一。
sentences.pinyin: xiě xià le qiān gǔ míng piān chì bì fù zhè shì tā de rén shēng dài biǎo zuò zhī yī
sentences.english: As he wandered among mountains and rivers with his friends, finding solace and healing in nature, ..

sentences.simplified: 从这里开始，他的作品转向人生哲理性思考，
sentences.traditional: 從這裡開始，他的作品轉向人生哲理性思考，
sentences.pinyin: cóng zhè lǐ kāi shǐ tā de zuò pǐn zhuǎn xiàng rén shēng zhé lǐ xìng sī kǎo
sentences.english: .. he composed the timeless masterpiece “Red Cliffs Rhapsody”, one of the defining works of his life.

sentences.simplified: 政治议题减少并转为隐喻。
sentences.traditional: 政治議題減少並轉為隱喻。
sentences.pinyin: zhèng zhì yì tí jiǎn shǎo bìng zhuǎn wéi yǐn yù
sentences.english: From this point, his writings turned toward philosophical reflections on life, ..
.. while political themes grew fewer and appeared only in metaphorical form.

sentences.simplified: 47岁时，苏轼接到调令，离开了生活了四年的黄州。
sentences.traditional: 47歲時，蘇軾接到調令，離開了生活了四年的黃州。
sentences.pinyin: 3 suì shí sū shì jiē dào diào lìng lí kāi le shēng huó le sì nián de huáng zhōu

sentences.simplified: 之后的岁月里，苏轼经历了反复升职和被贬。
sentences.traditional: 之後的歲月裡，蘇軾經歷了反覆升職和被貶。
sentences.pinyin: zhī hòu de suì yuè lǐ sū shì jīng lì le fǎn fù shēng zhí hé bèi biǎn
sentences.english: At the age of forty-seven, Su Shi received a transfer order and left Huangzhou, where he had lived for four years.

sentences.simplified: 他每到一个地方都会结交新朋友，发掘当地美食，
sentences.traditional: 他每到一個地方都會結交新朋友，發掘當地美食，
sentences.pinyin: tā měi dào yí ge dì fang dōu huì jié jiāo xīn péng you fā jué dāng dì měi shí
sentences.english: In the years that followed, Su Shi experienced repeated promotions and demotions.

sentences.simplified: 为当地老百姓办实事，包括修整堤坝、兴办教育等，
sentences.traditional: 為當地老百姓辦實事，包括修整堤壩、興辦教育等，
sentences.pinyin: wèi dāng dì lǎo bǎi xìng bàn shí shì bāo kuò xiū zhěng dī bà xīng bàn jiào yù děng
sentences.english: Wherever he went, he would make new friends, discover the local cuisine, ..

sentences.simplified: 现在杭州的“苏堤”就是他的执政成果。
sentences.traditional: 現在杭州的“蘇堤”就是他的執政成果。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài háng zhōu de sū dī jiù shì tā de zhí zhèng chéng guǒ
sentences.english: .. and do practical things for the local people, including repairing dikes and promoting education.

sentences.simplified: 最终，他在64岁时于常州病逝。
sentences.traditional: 最終，他在64歲時於常州病逝。
sentences.pinyin: zuì zhōng tā zài 3 suì shí yú cháng zhōu bìng shì
sentences.english: The “Su Causeway” in Hangzhou is one of his achievements in governance.
In the end, he passed away from illness in Changzhou at the age of sixty-four.

sentences.simplified: 这就是苏轼的一生：怀抱着为生民立命的儒家理想走进政坛，
sentences.traditional: 這就是蘇軾的一生：懷抱著為生民立命的儒家理想走進政壇，
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì sū shì de yì shēng huái bào zhe wèi shēng mín lì mìng de rú jiā lǐ xiǎng zǒu jìn zhèng tán

sentences.simplified: 却在政治斗争中质疑理想。
sentences.traditional: 卻在政治鬥爭中質疑理想。
sentences.pinyin: què zài zhèng zhì dòu zhēng zhōng zhì yí lǐ xiǎng
sentences.english: Such was the life of Su Shi: he entered officialdom with the Confucian ideal of securing a life of well-being for the people, ..

sentences.simplified: 最终他跟自己和解，走出了权力中心，一心为百姓做实事。
sentences.traditional: 最終他跟自己和解，走出了權力中心，一心為百姓做實事。
sentences.pinyin: zuì zhōng tā gēn zì jǐ hé jiě zǒu chū le quán lì zhōng xīn yì xīn wèi bǎi xìng zuò shí shì
sentences.english: .. yet came to question that very ideal amid the struggles of political strife.

sentences.simplified: 东坡居士在黄州城东的土坡上放下了一部分理想，坚持了一部分理想，
sentences.traditional: 東坡居士在黃州城東的土坡上放下了一部分理想，堅持了一部分理想，
sentences.pinyin: dōng pō jū shì zài huáng zhōu chéng dōng de tǔ pō shang fàng xià le yí bù fen lǐ xiǎng jiān chí le yí bù fen lǐ xiǎng
sentences.english: In the end, he made peace with himself, stepped out of the center of power, and devoted himself to doing practical things for the people.

sentences.simplified: 回答了自己的人生课题。
sentences.traditional: 回答了自己的人生課題。
sentences.pinyin: huí dá le zì jǐ de rén shēng kè tí
sentences.english: The Resident of the Eastern Slope, on the earthen rise east of Huangzhou, set aside part of his ideals, held fast to others, ..

sentence_translations: Resident of the Eastern Slope: The Life Questions of a Song Dynasty Official
In any discussion of Northern Song dynasty writers, Su Shi is an unavoidable epoch-making figure.
He broke with the tradition of Song ci that emphasized the delicate restraint style, pioneering the bold and unconstrained school.
His ci lyrics are bold and grand, a reflection of his optimistic personality.
This temperament not only drove him to achieve remarkable success in literature, ..
.. but also enabled him to face life’s adversities with an open and generous heart.
Su Shi, whose art name was the Resident of the Eastern Slope, was from Sichuan.
He was a famous writer and politician during the mid-Northern Song dynasty.
His father was a highly talented man who guided him and his younger brother in their education from an early age.
At the age of twenty, Su Shi went to the capital to sit for the imperial examinations, where he earned an impressive second place.
As for why he did not come first, it is said that there is a little story about that.
The Northern Song dynasty imperial examinations used anonymous marking.
This meant that the candidates’ names were concealed on the exam papers, ..
.. so the examiners would not know who the candidates were, thus ensuring fairness in the grading.
The examiner at the time was Ouyang Xiu (another famous writer and politician of the Northern Song dynasty).
When he read Su Shi’s exam paper, he thought it was exceptionally well-written and deserved first place.
However, his own student was also sitting the exam, and he thought this was his student’s exam paper.
To avoid any appearance of favoritism, he only awarded it second place.
When the results were announced, Ouyang Xiu realized that it was actually Su Shi’s essay, and so he especially admired Su Shi.
Just as Su Shi was preparing to make his mark in the capital, his mother passed away, ..
.. and so he returned to his hometown to observe the mourning rites.
The end of the mourning period happened to coincide with a special examination held by the court for selecting talented people.
Su Shi took part in the exam and earned the highest distinction, marking the beginning of his political career.
At the age of twenty-nine, Su Shi’s father passed away, and he returned to Sichuan to observe the mourning rites.
During this time, his official career was temporarily put on hold.
Three years later, Su Shi returned to the political arena and resumed his political career.
Su Shi was highly talented and accomplished, performing admirably in office and rising quickly through the ranks.
However, as he was never one to fuss over trivial formalities and was unable to restrain his sharp edge, ..
.. he gradually became the object of envy.
When he was forty-two, someone took a number of his poems, distorted their meaning, ..
.. and reported him to the emperor for satirizing the court and being disloyal to the emperor.
As a result, he was arrested and imprisoned, and faced the risk of execution.
During his days in prison, Su Shi endured great torment and even wrote a farewell poem to his younger brother.
This experience gave him a profound understanding of the treacherous nature of politics, ..
.. and became an important turning point in his thoughts and literary creation.
Three months later, with the help of his younger brother and other political figures, ..
.. the emperor commuted Su Shi’s death sentence and exiled him to Huangzhou in Hubei.
At that time, Huangzhou in Hubei was a remote and impoverished backwater with very harsh living conditions.
For a long period, Su Shi lodged in a temple. Later, when his circumstances improved somewhat, he moved out of the temple with his family.
With the help of his friends, he obtained a piece of wasteland. He cleared the wasteland and began a life of farming.
This piece of wasteland was a slope on the east side of the city, called the Eastern Slope.
Su Shi therefore humorously referred to himself as the “Resident of the Eastern Slope”.
Although life in Huangzhou was difficult, Su Shi’s optimistic attitude helped him to discover the beauty in life.
It is said that at that time, the people of Huangzhou could not afford mutton and could only buy fatty pork to eat.
He carefully studied the matter and invented the fatty but not greasy “Dongpo pork”, which became a timeless classic.
Su Shi’s period in Huangzhou marked the peak of his literary creation.
As he wandered among mountains and rivers with his friends, finding solace and healing in nature, ..
.. he composed the timeless masterpiece “Red Cliffs Rhapsody”, one of the defining works of his life.
From this point, his writings turned toward philosophical reflections on life, ..
.. while political themes grew fewer and appeared only in metaphorical form.
At the age of forty-seven, Su Shi received a transfer order and left Huangzhou, where he had lived for four years.
In the years that followed, Su Shi experienced repeated promotions and demotions.
Wherever he went, he would make new friends, discover the local cuisine, ..
.. and do practical things for the local people, including repairing dikes and promoting education.
The “Su Causeway” in Hangzhou is one of his achievements in governance.
In the end, he passed away from illness in Changzhou at the age of sixty-four.
Such was the life of Su Shi: he entered officialdom with the Confucian ideal of securing a life of well-being for the people, ..
.. yet came to question that very ideal amid the struggles of political strife.
In the end, he made peace with himself, stepped out of the center of power, and devoted himself to doing practical things for the people.
The Resident of the Eastern Slope, on the earthen rise east of Huangzhou, set aside part of his ideals, held fast to others, ..
.. and in doing so answered the questions of his own life.
